learning_outcomes.text: Explains the chemical structures, molecular bonding types, and structure-property relationships of elastomers, comparing their differences with thermoplastics and thermosets using scientific terms.
Explains the definition, history, and classification of elastomers, distinguishing between natural and synthetic elastomers through examples; correctly uses basic terminology.
Classifies the monomer composition, production method, cross-link density, and main application areas for natural rubber (NR) and synthetic elastomers (SBR, NBR, EPDM).
Explains the principles of Banbury/kneading, milling, compression molding, injection, and extrusion processes.
Evaluates the functions of fillers, plasticizers, vulcanization systems, antioxidants, flame retardants, pigments, UV stabilizers, and antistatic agents, being aware of target properties.

syllabus_topics: Overview of elastomer technology, Definition and history of elastomers
Chemical Structure and Molecular Properties of Elastomers, Chemical bonds and molecular structure, Structure-property relationships
Types of Elastomers – Natural Elastomers, Natural rubber: sources, structure and properties, Processing of natural rubber
Types of Elastomers – Synthetic Elastomers, General introduction to synthetic elastomers (SBR, NBR, EPDM), Properties and application areas of synthetic elastomers
Additives used in elastomers-1: fillers, plasticizers, vulcanization agents
Additives used in elastomers-2: antioxidants, anti-aging agents, flame retardants, color pigments, UV stabilizers and antistatic agents
Chemical resistance and environmental effects in elastomer materials -1: Oil, solvent, ozone and UV resistance
Chemical resistance and environmental effects in elastomer materials -2: Aging and degradation mechanisms (potential environmental damage)
General test methods applied to elastomers: Mechanical, thermal and chemical test techniques
General standards and methods applied to elastomers (ASTM D412, ASTM D2240, ASTM D573, ASTM D1149)
Future Trends in Elastomer Technology: Innovations in elastomer applications
